THE CAPTAIN'S LANDING - Experience the game from The Captain's Landing, located just behind Section 533. This exclusive standing room area gives you premium access to the nearby Captain Morgan bar. Plus, enjoy your first drink on us with a $10 beverage credit included with your purchase! A ticket in The Captain's Landing does not include a physical seat. Offer available only to fans ages 21 and up.
